title: Stage representatives of raw abelian Kan sections
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and put $I=(i\downarrow J)$; for $t\in I$ write $v_t=V_{t.right}$ and $f_t=F(t.hom)$. Equip each $F(j)$ with a precoverage $P_j$, with every transition functor continuous for the generated Grothendieck topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix an abelian sheaf $G$ on $F(i)$ and $U\in F(i)$, and put $A_t=f_{t,s}G$ and $U_t=f_t(U)$. Give sheaf maps $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^sA_{t'}$ for all $b:t\to t'$. Give a diagram $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(V.pt,\mathrm{Ab})$ and left Kan units $\beta_t:A_t\to v_t^pB_t$ (composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to v_t^pT$ for every abelian presheaf $T$). Assume $\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(\beta_t(X)B(b)(v_tX))=\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X))$ for each stage object $X$. Give a diagram $D:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ with isomorphisms $E_t:D_t\cong A_t(U_t)$. Set $Y=V_i(U)$ and $H=\operatorname{colim}B$. Suppose $\kappa_t:D_t\to H(Y)$ satisfies: there is an equality $e_t:v_t(U_t)=Y$ such that $\kappa_t$ is $E_t$, then $\beta_t(U_t)$, then the coprojection $B_t\to H$ at $v_t(U_t)$, then transport along $e_t$. Assume also $D(b)\kappa_{t'}=\kappa_t$ for every $b:t\to t'$. Then every $x\in H(Y)$ equals $\kappa_t(y)$ for some $t\in I$ and $y\in D_t$.

proof.text: An individual pointwise Kan generator (W,s,f) is represented by a D section. Reuse the proved private lift_under_arrow helper from ColimitSiteRawSectionGenerators through a proof-only import all: it lifts f, aligns its prescribed endpoints by eventual object equality, and equalizes the two maps out of i. Transport s with theta, restrict along the lift, and apply E inverse. Naturality of beta and the coprojections and hbeta_map prove the kappa formula for this representative. No set-valued Kan representative assertion is applied to the abelian Kan colimit.

The union S of the ranges of kappa is an additive subgroup: zero and negatives come from one stage, while a sum is represented at a common upper stage using hkappa_map and D.map additivity. For a fixed t, take the preimage of S under the evaluated coprojection B_t(Y) to H(Y). It contains every pointwise Kan generator by the preceding step.

A subgroup of the point of an abelian colimit containing every coprojection image equals the whole group. Prove this directly: corestrict the cocone legs to the subgroup, descend using IsColimit, and compose with the subgroup inclusion. Colimit hom_ext identifies this composite with the identity, so every element belongs to the subgroup. The proved private lemma colimit_mem_subgroup implements this argument. Apply it to the pointwise Kan cocone.

Evaluation and the abelian forgetful functor preserve filtered colimits. Thus every element of H(Y) comes from a B_t(Y); the preceding subgroup argument puts its image in S and gives the desired D representative.

theorem raw_abelian_section_generators
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (κ : ∀ t : Under i,
      D.obj t ⟶ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hκmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'), D.map b ≫ κ t' = κ t)
    (hκ : ∀ t : Under i,
        ∃ e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U) =
            (V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U,
          κ t =
            (E t).hom ≫ (β t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) ≫
              (colimit.ι B t).app
                (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun X => (colimit B).obj (op X)) e)) :
    ∀ x : (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)),
      ∃ (t : Under i) (y : D.obj t), κ t y = x
